'''Greddin Zel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Zel owned the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] engineering firm [[ZelFlight]], and secured an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] contract with the help of [[Zerex]], the [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Adinorr]]. When Zerex was promoted to become the [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]], Zel attended a celebratory party that Zerex held in his mansion, on Ord Adinorr.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
